source: scunpacked snapshot 20260801T204744Z, ship-items.json. CIG's own shipped values.
what: Every weapon-family item with a real name, with CIG's own type label, its class tags, its damage channels and its firing numbers.

damage_channels.note: Thermal, Biochemical and Stun are declared on all 185 guns carrying an ImpactDamage block and are ZERO on every one. A UI that renders all six channels shows three empty columns forever.

known_data_defect: CIG's own DescriptionData carries BOTH 'Plasma Canon' (2 items) and 'Plasma Cannon' (1 item). Grouping on that field produces two categories for one weapon class.
